title: Puzzle 5D React Parity
description: Get puzzle 5d to premigration level (git tag `premigration`, where puzzle/5d/react/index.tsx was a 5673-line react renderer with model/hover/flatten/brush/palette-drop/structural-delete/inspector-patch/store/five-d/kind-meta/2d-layout/2d-markers/play-host regions) for the react renderer on the migrated Rust plugin architecture: puzzle/plugin/rs/d5 emits UiTree interpreted by framework/renderer/react. Follow the approach of PUZZLE-2D-REACT-PARITY (26/07/09) and PUZZLE-3D-REACT-PARITY (26/07/09).
summary: Restored premigration-level puzzle 5d in the react renderer on the Rust plugin architecture. Rewrote puzzle/plugin/rs/d5/mod.rs following the closed 2D/3D parity tickets: the 2D window now emits a Puzzle2dBoardScene (GPU board host with grid, hit-testing, marquee, drag, board events) projected from the paired 5d document (parts→nodes, grips→handles with full ids, fasteners→edges, kindCatalogs→nodes/handles/edges/wires), with applyBoardEvents mapping camera/select/nodeMove/edgeCreate/nodeDelete/brushPlace back into the envelope. The 3D window reached d3 protocol parity: worldPick/setHover/setTransformTool, selection JSON with granularity/targets/transformTool/gumballActive/gumballTarget/activeObjectId, context menu (duplicate/select-same-kind/zoom/delete, zoom targets both cameras). Select/Brush/Fill engagements with fill slider + engine-driven brush candidate toggle group and REPL input on both windows; measures (2D LOD select, suggestion offset, part/grip kind weights, brush overlap budget). Panels: document tree with Parts(+nested grips)+Fasteners and selection reflection, catalogue derived from kindCatalogs (draggable part kinds for board palette drop via addNode), inspector with editable part (kind/label/text/x/y/origin) and grip (kind/angle/radius/position/direction) fields via patchPart/patchGrip. Paired behaviors: selection and hover shared across both surfaces (board scene gained hovered_id/active_tool in framework core + host sync via setHoveredIdSilent/setActiveTool), engine fixture adoption now merges instead of wiping flat aspects (fill/brush place paired parts, new parts get synthesized flat centers walked along fasteners), 5d kindCatalogs projected to engine naming so brush candidates resolve. Fixed the document format at the root: fasteners use source/target (Nakagin never parsed before), struct now lossless (meta/label/iconKind/hidden/locked/width/height preserved). Verified: 32/32 d5 cargo tests, 47/47 react renderer tests, wasm round-trip harness against the transpiled component (board scenes for both fixtures, paired select/hover, gumball fields, context menu, fill slider, measures, panels), and a live browser boot on :6014 showing the board grid + new panels; sustained interactive browser verification was blocked by concurrent playground sessions clobbering framework/plugin/registry/generated (flagged as separate infra task).
